constants.STAR: float star(vec2 q, float sz){ float r = length(q), a = atan(q.y, q.x); return pow(abs(cos(a*2.)), 12.)*exp(-r/sz*1.4) + exp(-r*r/(sz*sz*.08)); } float h1(float n){ return fract(sin(n*91.7)*43758.5); }

constants.ORBF: vec3 orbP(vec3 o, float a, float k, float b){ return o + vec3(cos(a)*${F(SP_R)}*k, ${F(SP_H)} + b + sin(a)*${F(SP_R*SP_TILT)}*k, -sin(a)*${F(SP_R)}*k); }
